biggest_catch: Official userlytics.com page confirms PayPal payments every 15 days for approved tests, but no official page states a concrete dollar payout per test — only third-party sites quote '$5-$90'.
catches: No dollar amount appears on userlytics.com's own tester/payment pages; the '$5-$90 per test' figure comes only from review sites and aggregators.
Payment is made only after the client reviews and approves your test feedback, which adds an undefined review delay before the 15-day cycle starts.
Test invitations are infrequent — reviewers report roughly one invite per month, so this is not a steady earner.
No minimum payout threshold and no cash-out action needed (automatic PayPal), per official page.
